scripts.setup: npm ci && cargo fetch --locked && cargo install cargo-machete --version 0.9.2 --locked && cargo install cargo-deny --version 0.20.2 --locked && npm run hooks:install
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && prettier --write src scripts config *.json *.ts index.html
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features text-refinement-worker/test-fixture --locked -- -D warnings && npm run check:fast && node scripts/check-contracts.mjs && npm run check:dependencies:rust
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --features text-refinement-worker/test-fixture --locked && vitest run --passWithNoTests && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:quality
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run coverage && npm run coverage:host && npm run coverage:refinement && npm run test:guardrails && node scripts/secrets.mjs && cargo deny check && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.check:fast: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && oxlint --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error src scripts tests/tooling tools tests/fixtures/browser-fields/validate.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs && eslint src scripts/**/*.ts tests/tooling tools tests/fixtures/browser-fields/validate.ts && node scripts/guardrails.mjs && node scripts/architecture.mjs && npm run check:format && npm run check:dependencies
scripts.test:portable: vitest run --maxWorkers=2 && node --test scripts/guardrails.test.mjs scripts/architecture.test.mjs scripts/async-guardrails.test.mjs scripts/coverage.test.mjs scripts/dependency-guardrails.test.mjs
scripts.check:format: prettier --check src scripts config tests/tooling tools/**/*.ts tests/fixtures/native-contract/*.json tests/fixtures/browser-fields/validate.ts *.json *.ts *.mjs index.html
scripts.check:dependencies:rust: cargo machete crates/dictation-core crates/macos-integration crates/text-refinement-protocol crates/text-refinement-worker src-tauri
scripts.check:refinement: cargo clippy -p text-refinement-protocol -p text-refinement-worker --no-default-features --features text-refinement-worker/test-fixture --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
